transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, the main thing is I just keep getting pulled off track by every little sound or thought. Like, I’ll sit down to work on a job application, and then... I don't know, a car goes by outside, or my phone lights up, or just some random idea pops into my head. It just sends me off doing something completely different before I even notice I stopped working. It's making it really hard to get anything done.
When did you first start having trouble with your focus and getting distracted like this?

Honestly, it goes way back. Like... even in elementary school, I remember it being a problem. My teachers were always having to move my seat because I'd talk out of turn all the time. And I was always forgetting my homework, or, you know, I'd just rush through my worksheets and make a bunch of careless mistakes. So, yeah, it's been happening pretty much since I was a kid.
Do you often find yourself feeling restless, fidgeting, or feeling like you're constantly on the go?

Yeah, I definitely do. Um, since I can’t play soccer like before, just... sitting around the house makes me feel like I’m crawling out of my skin. I just can't stay still. I usually end up just pacing from room to room because I feel like I need to be moving.
